title: Halo Dental footer
description: Rounded pure-black footer framed by a narrow outer margin: three navigation columns on the left, an outlined product button and vermilion CTA on the right, a full-width technical line-drawing instrument wireframe with concentric target rings across the middle, and legal links + copyright at the bottom.
notes: forces .dark by default so the rounded black footer matches Halo's dark bookend layout
diagram slot accepts a custom wireframe graphic, defaulting to a token-styled horizontal instrument blueprint on desktop and vertical blueprint on mobile
